recentItems.title: NVIDIA CEO Quits, Data Center Backlash, Anthropic IPO: Can the A.I. Boom Last? What You Need to Know
recentItems.description:
Rachel Scott has the latest on Jensen Huang's stepping down from CEO of Nvidia, as well as the stock market concerns. Elizabeth Schulze reports.
Plus, how another A.I. giant is preparing for a massive wall street debut, how data centers became a flashpoint in the midterm elections, and three
places you may not expect to find Nvidia's technology, along with other headlines you need to know this weekend.

00:25: SCANDAL ROCKS NVIDIA: A leadership shakeup at one of the most powerful companies in the world after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia.
01:18: WHAT/WHEN DID TRUMP KNOW?: President Trump had publicly backed Huang before the CEO's resignation.
02:28: ANTHROPIC GOING PUBLIC: The A.I. giant is seeking a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion dollars in its upcoming IPO.
02:32: A.I. DATA CENTERS BATTLE:  The rapid expansion of A.I data centers became a flashpoint in the Midterm Elections causing concerns amongst Americans.
03:15: STOCK MARKET CONCERNS: Communities are worried about the cost of data centers following Jensen Huang' resignation.  
04:58: THE CARS WE DRIVE: Nvidia is working with automakers in developing new technology to improve the driving experience.
05:15: THE MEDICINE WE TAKE: Nvidia’s A.I. technology helps researchers study diseases and speed up research for new forms of medicine.
05:30: NVIDIA IN VIDEO GAMES: Nvidia's graphics processors power millions of computers to enhance the gaming experience.
--
